questions.text: Abortion should be legal in all or most cases.
questions.agree: Supports keeping abortion legal in all or most cases
questions.disagree: Opposes legal abortion in most cases

questions.text: Abortion should be banned once cardiac activity is detected (about six weeks), except to save the mother’s life.
questions.agree: Supports a six-week abortion limit
questions.disagree: Opposes a six-week abortion limit

questions.text: Taxes on households earning more than $400,000 a year should go up.
questions.agree: Supports higher taxes on incomes over $400K
questions.disagree: Opposes raising taxes on high earners

questions.text: Cutting government spending is the best way to bring down inflation and living costs.
questions.agree: Prioritizes spending cuts to fight inflation
questions.disagree: Does not see spending cuts as the main fix for inflation

questions.text: People living in the U.S. illegally should have a path to citizenship if they meet set requirements.
questions.agree: Supports a path to citizenship for undocumented residents
questions.disagree: Opposes a path to citizenship for those here illegally

questions.text: Deporting people living in the U.S. illegally should be a top enforcement priority.
questions.agree: Makes deportation a top enforcement priority
questions.disagree: Opposes making mass deportation a priority

questions.text: Sexual orientation and gender identity should be protected under federal civil-rights law.
questions.agree: Supports civil-rights protections for sexual orientation and gender identity
questions.disagree: Opposes adding sexual orientation and gender identity to civil-rights law

questions.text: Transgender athletes should compete in the category that matches their sex at birth.
questions.agree: Supports sports categories based on sex at birth
questions.disagree: Supports letting transgender athletes compete by gender identity

questions.text: Public education funds should follow students to private or religious schools (school choice).
questions.agree: Supports school choice and vouchers
questions.disagree: Opposes using public funds for private-school vouchers

questions.text: Parents should have the final say over curriculum and library books in public schools.
questions.agree: Supports parents having final say on curriculum and library books
questions.disagree: Prefers that educators and school boards set curriculum

questions.text: The federal government should guarantee health coverage for every American.
questions.agree: Supports a federal guarantee of health coverage
questions.disagree: Opposes a federal coverage guarantee; favors market options

questions.text: The government should negotiate or cap prescription drug prices.
questions.agree: Supports government negotiation or caps on drug prices
questions.disagree: Opposes government drug-price controls

questions.text: Government should require a transition away from fossil fuels to cut emissions.
questions.agree: Supports a required transition away from fossil fuels
questions.disagree: Opposes mandates to phase out fossil fuels

questions.text: Expanding domestic oil, gas and pipeline production should be a priority.
questions.agree: Supports expanding domestic oil, gas and pipelines
questions.disagree: Opposes expanding fossil-fuel production

questions.text: Cash bail should be eliminated for people charged with nonviolent offenses.
questions.agree: Supports ending cash bail for nonviolent offenses
questions.disagree: Supports keeping cash bail

questions.text: Increasing police funding and staffing is the best way to reduce crime.
questions.agree: Supports more police funding and staffing
questions.disagree: Favors shifting some police funding to other services

questions.text: The U.S. should keep sending military and financial aid to allies in active wars.
questions.agree: Supports continued aid to allies in active conflicts
questions.disagree: Opposes continued foreign war aid

questions.text: U.S. defense spending should increase.
questions.agree: Supports increasing defense spending
questions.disagree: Supports holding or cutting defense spending

questions.text: Government should be required to balance its budget, even if that means cutting programs.
questions.agree: Supports a balanced-budget requirement
questions.disagree: Opposes a balanced-budget requirement

questions.text: More decisions and dollars should shift from the federal government to state and local governments.
questions.agree: Supports shifting power and funding to state and local government
questions.disagree: Supports a strong federal role in funding and standards

questions.text: Ten Commandments displays and staff-led prayer should be allowed in public schools.
questions.agree: Supports allowing Ten Commandments displays and staff-led prayer in public schools
questions.disagree: Opposes religious displays and staff-led prayer in public schools

questions.text: Business owners should be able to decline services that conflict with their religious beliefs.
questions.agree: Supports letting businesses decline services on religious grounds
questions.disagree: Opposes religious exemptions from anti-discrimination rules

questions.text: Background checks should be required for all gun sales, including private sales.
questions.agree: Supports universal background checks
questions.disagree: Opposes background checks on private sales

questions.text: Adults should be able to carry a handgun without a permit.
questions.agree: Supports permitless carry
questions.disagree: Opposes permitless carry
